Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

In the sect's early nights, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} antitribu anarchs played an instrumental role in shaping the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}, helping establish much of its structure and beliefs following the Convention of Thorns. Where their @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} kin are drawn to art and beauty, the Sabbat @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} - sometimes called the Perverts - have become fascinated instead with pain and displeasure, their own or others'.

Disciplines: Auspex, Celerity, Presence

Advantage: Moving easily through society lets Toreador antitribu absorb the concerns of those they meet; each gains any combination of two Traits from Academics, Crafts, Performance, or Subterfuge (the same Trait may be taken twice) at no extra cost during character creation.

Disadvantage: When confronted with a scene of pain or an opportunity to cause harm, however minor, a Toreador antitribu must indulge the dark passion it stirs or spend a Mental Trait to resist the temptation.

Organization: Toreador antitribu remain influential voices within Sabbat leadership circles, drawing on their early role in founding the sect's structures and rites.
